['FMG Flughafen M\u00fcnchen GmbH '].company_description: Flughafen München GmbH (FMG) is the operator of Munich Airport, which is an international airport serving Munich and Upper Bavaria. It is the second-busiest airport in Germany in terms of passenger traffic after Frankfurt Airport, and the ninth-busiest airport in Europe. The airport serves as a hub for Lufthansa and its subsidiaries, as well as a base for other airlines such as Condor and TUI fly Deutschland.

['DPD GeoPost (Deutschland) GmbH '].company_description: DPD GeoPost (Deutschland) GmbH operates as a parcel shipping company, providing domestic and international parcel shipping services, including logistics optimization and planning. The company offers various delivery options such as DPD CLASSIC, DPD 8:30, DPD 10:00, DPD 12:00, DPD 18:00, DPD PARCELLetter, and DPD Guarantee.
